note: Warmth (Dave 2026-10-21: cold costs health, slowly down to 1, like hunger). A vital 0 to 100 shown as the Warmth bar at the top of the inventory and Tab screens only. Each slow tick the server works out the warmth the body is heading for: 100 minus the cold stress. Stress is the degrees below comfort_c (air temperature from the weather and altitude, less wind chill when exposed, plus fire_c near a lit fire), times up to rain_mult when wet (Dave 5 Nov rain card: Rain x1.5; only shelter dries you): a soak level 0 to 1 rises soak_per_h toward the rain's strength in rain or snow on you (swimming soaks you through), and out of it falls only in shelter, dry_cover_per_h under a tree or roof and dry_fire_per_h within a lit fire's heat reach; in the open you stay wet, times water_mult when swimming, times gain, cut by the clothing insulation (0 to 0.85; no clothes exist yet, insulation_of is the hook). Warmth moves toward that target with a time constant in game hours (tau_cool falling, tau_warm rising: a fire warms you quicker than the cold chills you). Below cold_at you shiver (exertion rises faster, health stops regenerating); below hurt_at cold costs health hurt_per_s, more the colder, never below 1. Messages use two levels so they do not flicker. Swimming (Tyler): the stress comes from the WATER temperature instead of the air: water_c = water_base_c + water_follow x (air at sea level - water_base_c), never under 1 C; stress = water_comfort_c - water_c, times water_gain (so 10 C water cuts the target to about 20 and 25 C water barely matters); the body cools with tau_water_h instead of tau_cool_h. Day and night: the weather's temp_c carries the swing itself (one temperature for weather, warmth, ice and snow: docs/design/one_temperature.md, src/shared/climate.gd). Server side only. Caves (Jamie's caves page, #664; coordinator decision 8 Nov 2026 from Jamie's CONTRADICTIONS.md, Dave may revert): inside a cave with rock over you (cover_at 2, cave_mean_c) the air is the island's year mean less the lapse with its height (Climate.year_mean_c), with no day and night swing, no rain cooling and no wind, and a cave pool's water is the same (cave_pool_c is only the fallback where no cave is known); rain does not reach you, and the air is near saturated, so only a lit fire dries you there.

body_703.note: The body in weather (docs/design/body_in_weather_design.md; Jamie #703 body-in-weather.md, coordinator 8 Nov 2026, Dave may revert). Off by default: with enabled false every number above stands. On: wool dries 0.4 soak an hour by a fire and 0.1 under cover; wet plus wind multiplies the cold stress by 1 + (rain_mult - 1) x soak + wet_wind_gain x soak x wind and strips insulation by wet_strip x soak x min(wind / wet_strip_wind, 1); cold stages on the warmth bar: mild under cold_at, moderate under hurt_at (actions moderate_pace times as long), severe under severe_at (severe_pace, the health drain x severe_hurt_mult, still never below 1); shivering stops under shiver_stop_at.
body_703.say_severe: You have stopped shivering. Get to a fire, now.
